claim: NATS 统一了 messaging、streaming、state（JetStream）
quote: NATS unifies messaging, streaming, and state into one real-time system — connecting services, devices, and AI agents from cloud to edge.

claim: NATS 单二进制、内置 JetStream、亚毫秒延迟、45+ 客户端
quote: single binary with minimal resource usage and sub-millisecond latency. Official clients are available in Go, Rust, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, C, Ruby, Elixir

claim: NATS 基于 subject 的寻址是 M:N，location-independent
quote: NATS manages addressing and discovery based on subjects and not hostname and ports. Defaulting to M:N communications
locator: What makes the NATS connective technology unique

claim: subject 命名规范、token 与 wildcard 规则
quote: Allowed characters: Any Unicode character except null, space, ., * and >. Recommended: a-z, A-Z, 0-9, - and _
locator: Characters allowed and recommended for subject names

claim: 单 token 通配 * 和多 token 通配 >
quote: * will match a single token. > which will match one or more tokens, and can only appear at the end of the subject

claim: subject 设计最佳实践
quote: Use the first token(s) to establish a general namespace. Use the final token(s) for identifiers. A subject should be used for more than one message.

claim: Request-Reply 用 inbox subject 实现
quote: A request is published on a given subject using a reply subject. Responders listen on that subject and send responses to the reply subject. Reply subjects are called inbox.
locator: NATS makes Request-Reply simple and powerful

claim: Request-Reply 多响应：取第一个，其余自动丢弃
quote: The power of NATS even allows multiple responses, where the first response is utilized and the system efficiently discards the additional ones.
locator: NATS makes Request-Reply simple and powerful

claim: 无响应者会返回 503 no-responders 状态
quote: When enabled, a request sent to a subject with no subscribers will immediately receive a reply that has no body, and a 503 status.

claim: Queue Group 是天然的负载均衡
quote: If a subscriber is registered based on a queue name, it will always receive messages it is subscribed to... if more subscribers are added to the same queue name, they become a queue group, and only one randomly chosen subscriber of the queue group will consume a message

claim: Queue Group 跨集群仍然遵守本地优先
quote: If the same queue group exists in multiple clusters, the server will pick one member from the queue group in its cluster, only sending to a different cluster if there is no interest in its cluster.

claim: JetStream 内置于 nats-server，提供持久化与回放
quote: JetStream is the built-in persistence layer in nats-server. It captures published messages, stores them, and lets you replay them to consumers later

claim: JetStream 三种 retention 策略
quote: limits (the default) is to provide a replay of messages in the stream. work queue... interest (messages are kept in the stream for as long as there are consumers that haven't delivered the message yet)

claim: Stream replication 推荐 R=3，R=5 容忍双节点故障
quote: Replicas=3 - Can tolerate the loss of one server servicing the stream. Replicas=5 - Can tolerate simultaneous loss of two servers

claim: JetStream 一致性：写 linearizable，读近似 serializable
quote: For writes... the formal consistency model of NATS JetStream is Linearizable. On the read side... JetStream is serializable because messages are added to a stream in one global order

claim: JetStream 至少一次 + Exactly Once 依赖 Msg-Id 与双重 ack
quote: For the publishing side, it relies on the publishing application attaching a unique message or publication ID in a message header and on the server keeping track of those IDs... For the subscribers a double acknowledgment mechanism is used

claim: JetStream 默认 sync_interval 2 分钟，OS 故障窗口下需配置 always
quote: The server uses a configurable sync_interval option, with a default value of 2 minutes... Setting sync_interval: always will make sure servers fsync after every message

claim: Stream 支持 Source/Mirror/SubjectTransform/AllowRollup/RePublish
quote: When a stream is configured with a source or mirror, it will automatically and asynchronously replicate messages from the origin stream.

claim: RePublish 把 Stream 写入实时回放给 Core NATS 订阅者
quote: If enabled, the RePublish stream option will result in the server re-publishing messages received into a stream automatically and immediately after a successful write, to a distinct destination subject.

claim: Consumer 有 push/pull × durable/ephemeral 组合
quote: Consumers can be push-based where messages will be delivered to a specified subject or pull-based which allows clients to request batches of messages on demand.

claim: 推荐新项目用 pull consumer
quote: We recommend pull consumers for new projects. In particular when scalability, detailed flow control or error handling are a concern.

claim: AckPolicy: Explicit/None/All/FlowControl
quote: AckExplicit: The default policy. AckNone: No acknowledgment needed. AckAll: Acknowledge only the last message received in a series. AckFlowControl: (2.14) Messages are acknowledged based on flow control.

claim: KV 是 Stream 抽象，bucket 名称以 KV_ 开头
quote: Buckets are materialized as Streams (with a name starting with KV_), everything you can do with a bucket you can do with a Stream

claim: KV 提供 watch 与 history 接口
quote: watch: watch for changes happening for a key... watch all: watch for all the changes happening on all the keys in the bucket. history: retrieve a history of the values (and delete operations)
locator: Treating the Key Value store as a message stream

claim: KV 提供 create/update 原子操作
quote: create: associate the value with a key only if there is currently no value associated with that key. update: compare and set (aka compare and swap) the value for a key
locator: Atomic operations used for locking and concurrency control

claim: Object Store 通过分块传输支持任意大小对象
quote: The key being replaced by a file name and value being designed to store arbitrarily large objects (e.g. files, even if they are very large) rather than values that are message-sized (i.e. limited to 1Mb by default). This is achieved by chunking messages.

claim: NATS 安全体系：多租户 + 多种认证 + 细粒度授权
quote: Client connections can be authenticated in many ways... Authenticated clients are identified as users and have a set of authorizations. You can use accounts for multi-tenancy

claim: 认证支持 token / user+password / nkey / TLS / JWT / auth callout
quote: Token Authentication, Plain Text Username/Password, Bcrypt Passwords, TLS Certificate, NKEY, Decentralized JWT Authentication, Username/Password

claim: Accounts 是天然的多租户 + subject 命名空间隔离
quote: Accounts allow the grouping of clients, isolating them from clients in other accounts, thus enabling multi-tenancy in the server. With accounts, the subject space is not globally shared

claim: Accounts 间通过 stream/service export & import 通信
quote: Messaging exchange between different accounts is enabled by exporting streams and services from one account and importing them into another. Each account controls what is exported and imported.

claim: Cluster 节点自动形成 full mesh，客户端透明切换
quote: NATS servers achieve this by gossiping about and connecting to, all of the servers they know, thus dynamically forming a full mesh. Once clients connect or re-connect to a particular server, they are informed about current cluster members.

claim: Cluster 路由只转发 1 跳
quote: NATS clustered servers have a forwarding limit of one hop. This means that each nats-server instance will only forward messages that it has received from a client to the immediately adjacent nats-server instances to which it has routes.

claim: Leaf Node 适合 IoT/边缘，本地优先
quote: Leaf nodes are useful in IoT and edge scenarios and when the local server traffic should be low RTT and local unless routed to the super cluster. NATS queue semantics are honored across leaf connections by serving local queue consumers first.

claim: Leaf Node 不会重新发现，但可以被本端用作对外桥
quote: A leaf node can have multiple remotes, each connecting to a different cluster.

claim: 2.10 支持 LeafNode TLS-first 握手
quote: As of NATS v2.10.0, Leafnode connections... can be configured to perform a TLS handshake before sending the INFO protocol message.

claim: Gateway 用于跨 Region 拼接 Cluster 形成 Super-Cluster
quote: Gateways enable connecting one or more clusters together into a full mesh; they allow the formation of superclusters from smaller clusters.

claim: Gateway 3 cluster 节点对比 cluster 的连接数差异
quote: For 3 clusters, with 1 node each: 3 vs 1. With 2 nodes: 12 vs 6. With 3 nodes: 18 vs 18

claim: NATS 内置 HTTP 监控，/varz /connz /routez /jsz
quote: To monitor the NATS messaging system, nats-server provides a lightweight HTTP server on a dedicated monitoring port.

claim: 安装途径：brew/scoop/Docker/go install/curl
quote: The simplest way to get the nats-server binary for your machine is to use the following shell command. curl -fsSL https://binaries.nats.dev/nats-io/nats-server/v2@v2.11.6 | sh
locator: Getting the binary from the command line

claim: JetStream 生产部署推荐至少 4 核 8 GiB
quote: For production deployment of JetStream, we recommend starting with at least 4 CPU cores and 8 GiB of memory

claim: Docker 镜像 < 10 MB，4222/8222/6222 端口
quote: The NATS server Docker image is extremely lightweight, coming in under 10 MB in size. 4222 is for clients. 8222 is an HTTP management port. 6222 is a routing port for clustering.

claim: Core NATS at-most-once，JetStream at-least-once + exactly-once
quote: Core NATS, offers at-most-once delivery... NATS JetStream offers persistence with at-least-once and exactly-once (within a time window) delivery.

claim: NATS 默认 max payload 1MB，可上调到 64MB
quote: The size is set to 1 MB by default, but can be increased up to 64 MB if needed
locator: Is there a message size limitation

claim: NATS 单服务器默认 65,536 个连接
quote: The default setting for a single server is 65,536
locator: How many clients can connect simultaneously

claim: NATS 顺序保证是 per-publisher 而非跨 publisher
quote: NATS implements source ordered delivery per publisher. There are no guarantees of message delivery order amongst multiple publishers.
locator: Does NATS offer any guarantee of message ordering

claim: NATS 2.10 引入文件存储改进、LeafNode TLS-first、metadata
quote: Although all existing client versions will work, new client versions will expose additional options used to leverage new features. The minimum client versions that have full 2.10.0 support include:
This release contains fixes for CVE-2025-30215, a CRITICAL severity vulnerability affecting all NATS Server versions from v2.2.0, prior to v2.11.1 or v2.10.27.

claim: 选型对比：NATS 适合轻量服务通信、Kafka 高吞吐事件流、RabbitMQ 复杂路由
quote: Kafka for ordered event streams with replay; RabbitMQ for flexible task routing with competing consumers; NATS for lightweight service communication
locator: Kafka vs RabbitMQ vs NATS vs SQS

claim: 三方吞吐基准：NATS 在 pub-sub/req-reply 模式里延迟最低
quote: This post covers throughput testing of all three brokers on two messaging patterns: async producer-consumer queue, and request-reply
